item.text: {"claim_count":28,"content_failure_reasons":["The public-revenue claim adds that the 2.5% increase over 2021 was \"in real terms,\" but block 4 does not label that particular increase as real.","The contrary-material synthesis incorrectly describes \"lower IEPS fuel subsidy outlays\" as a favorable driver; block 4 instead reports lower IEPS tax collection resulting from the fuel subsidy."],"content_usable":true,"material_omission":true,"material_omission_explanation":"The map omits several relevant facts: 1.3 million net IMSS jobs from December 2018 to December 2022 and the comparison with the Fox and Calderón periods; a reported $19 billion reduction in capital outflows versus 2021; the 1.6% historical comparator for gross fixed investment; and that 25.2% physical-investment growth was the highest since 2009. It also omits the qualification that the 2.4 million jobs were reportedly mostly formal. These omissions reduce completeness for evaluating economic management but do not remove or distort evidence decisive enough to make the map unusable.","schema_version":"reader_content_audit_v1","source_id":"GOV-003","supported_claim_count":26,"unsupported_claim_count":2,"usable_locator_count":26}
